research_sources.insight: June 2026 is peak summer wedding season; Islamic auspicious dates in June–July drive the highest-intent search traffic among Muslim matrimony seekers globally.
Nearly 8 in 10 Muslims globally now use online matchmaking platforms, yet trust remains the #1 barrier to conversion.
Photo privacy is Muslim women's top safety concern: blur-by-default controls are proven conversion-critical trust signals.
NikahForever differentiates via picture blurring and manual profile verification; Shaadi.com positions as 'India's Most Trusted'.
Wali/guardian involvement is a genuine product need for diaspora Muslims in UK, USA, Canada.
NRI matrimony is growing in 2026 — cross-border introductions require extra verification and privacy controls.
